errors.text_span: Етикетите по оста Y са разположени на интервали от приблизително 1,5 до 2 единици.
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a Y-axis with tick labels. The values are presented as data labels directly above each point on the line.

errors.text_span: На графиката е изобразена една линия, която е показана в бяло, без маркери.
errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the line style is dashed, which is a key visual feature. The prompt explicitly asks for the line style (e.g., solid, dashed).

errors.text_span: След това линията намалява до (2014, 45,2), след което отново намалява до (2020, 33,3).
errors.evidence: This description of the trend after 2012 is incorrect. The line decreases from 2012 to 2015 (to a value of 43.7), then increases in 2016 (to 45.6), before decreasing again. The description completely omits the period of increase between 2015 and 2016.

errors.text_span: Наблюдава се равен участък между 2011 и 2012 година, където стойността е 51,8 и 52,3, както и между 2018 и 2019 година, където стойността е 33,7 и 34,1.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies these periods as a "равен участък" (flat section). In a flat section, values are constant. Here, the values clearly change (from 51.8 to 52.3 and from 33.7 to 34.1), indicating an increase in both cases.

The description uses the plural "спадовете" (troughs) but only identifies the single absolute minimum value in 2020. This is an oversimplification, as there are other local minima, for example in 2015 (43.7) and 2018 (33.7).
